description:
container to allow for easy population of all data returned by gemini into model classes - will later be
flattened before pushing to database tables

items.description: Definition of invoice line item fields to be extracted by Gemini - fed into gemini to form the output schema

cases.description: Number of cases for the line item - synonyms: cartons, boxes.

units.description: Number of units for the line item - synonyms: pieces.

description.description: Description of the product or service. synonyms: title, desc, name

size.description: Size or dimensions of the item. synonyms: pack size

code.description: Product or item code. synonyms: sku, catalogue number

value_ex_vat.description: Value of the line item excluding VAT to 2 decimal places.

value_inc_vat.description: Value of the line item including VAT to 2 decimal places.

vat_percentage.description: VAT percentage as a float (e.g., 0.20 for 20%).

is_delivery.description: Whether the line item is delivery.

invoice_details.description:
Definition of invoice meta fields to be extracted from the invoice by Gemini
Only fields to be extracted directly from the invoice by Gemini are included here.
Inclusion of extaneous fields, such as parsing time and token usage, would cause an increase in gemini token usage
and runtime as the AI engine would look for these data in the parsed invoice

calculated_total.description: Sum of the total of all line items, taking into account the VAT rate for each line. This should be calculated from the extracted line items.

invoice_total.description: The total invoice amount including VAT, as displayed on the invoice.

delivery_cost.description: This may appear as a line item on the invoice with a carrier name such as DPD, royal mail, fed ex, ups or other delivery providers.Total delivery cost. Default to 0.0 if not found on invoice

document_type.description: Type of duocument, e.g. invoice, packing_list, order_confirmation,receipt

invoice_date.description: Date on which the invoice was created - must be converted to ISO date format.

confidence_score.description: Confidence score from Gemini of confidence in accuracy of parsing of the invoice.
